name: hanyu
description: A personal app for learning to read Chinese

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w shared && npm run seed:dev -w server
scripts.data:build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build:seed -w data
